Recommended mud weight for Kopili in Bag.answer_text:
KOPILI MUD WEIGHT GUIDANCE · BAGHJAN
Recommended 13.3–13.7 ppg entering Kopili in the Baghjan area, based on 5 wells with Kopili penetration.

RECOMMENDED MUD WEIGHT
• 13.3–13.7 ppg before entering Kopili; raise before the transition, not after the first kick sign
• Pore pressure up to 13.0 ppg · fracture gradient 14.8 ppg at the pressure peak → usable window ≈ 1.9 ppg
• Offset wells drilled Kopili with 12.3–13.3 ppg

WELL-CONTROL HISTORY
• BGJ-12 · 3,803 m: Critical kick with 12.4 ppg — Well shut in; recorded SIDPP 686 psi. Weighted up to 12.8 ppg using wait-and-weight method before resuming…
• BGJ-12 · 3,947 m: Critical kick with 12.9 ppg — Well shut in; recorded SIDPP 631 psi. Weighted up to 13.4 ppg using wait-and-weight method before resuming…
• BGJ-12 · 3,884 m: Critical kick with 12.6 ppg — Flow-checked, closed BOP, circulated influx out and increased MW to 13.1 ppg with kill-line monitoring.

LOSS SENSITIVITY
• BGJ-05 · 3,938 m: losses with 12.8 ppg — keep ECD below 14.5 ppg
• BGJ-08 · 4,037 m: losses with 13.3 ppg — keep ECD below 14.5 ppg

RECOMMENDED ACTION
Raise mud weight to the recommended value before the transition, flow-check every connection, slow-drill the top 30 m and confirm BOP test status.

Show lessons learned for mud losses in T.title: TIPAM OFFSET EXPERIENCE
Show lessons learned for mud losses in T.summary: 12 relevant incidents identified across 8 nearby wells (within 15 km of DLJ-ACT-01).

sections.heading: COMMON INDICATORS
items: Pit volume decrease
Standpipe pressure drop
Reduced returns at flowline

sections.heading: HISTORICAL MITIGATION
items: Staged LCM (calcium carbonate + fibre) and drilled ahead at reduced pump rate with continuous pit monitoring.
Reduced mud weight by 0.2 ppg and spotted a cross-linked LCM pill across the loss zone.
Pumped 52 ppb LCM pill (fine/medium) and reduced flow rate to lower ECD; losses cured after 10.8 hrs.

sections.heading: LESSONS LEARNED
items: Reduce ECD (lower flow, controlled ROP) when approaching the Tipam loss zone.
Pre-treat mud with LCM before entering Tipam sands; keep pills staged on surface.
Loss zones in Tipam correlate across the field; anticipate them at similar depth.

sections.heading: RECOMMENDED ACTION
sections.text: Pre-treat mud with fine/medium LCM, reduce ECD by lowering flow rate and keep LCM pills staged before entering the interval.

TIPAM OFFSET EXPERIENCE
12 relevant incidents identified across 8 nearby wells (within 15 km of DLJ-ACT-01).

PRIMARY RISK
Mud Loss — 12 of 12 incidents

COMMON INDICATORS
• Pit volume decrease
• Standpipe pressure drop
• Reduced returns at flowline

HISTORICAL MITIGATION
• Staged LCM (calcium carbonate + fibre) and drilled ahead at reduced pump rate with continuous pit monitoring.
• Reduced mud weight by 0.2 ppg and spotted a cross-linked LCM pill across the loss zone.
• Pumped 52 ppb LCM pill (fine/medium) and reduced flow rate to lower ECD; losses cured after 10.8 hrs.

LESSONS LEARNED
• Reduce ECD (lower flow, controlled ROP) when approaching the Tipam loss zone.
• Pre-treat mud with LCM before entering Tipam sands; keep pills staged on surface.
• Loss zones in Tipam correlate across the field; anticipate them at similar depth.

RECOMMENDED ACTION
Pre-treat mud with fine/medium LCM, reduce ECD by lowering flow rate and keep LCM pills staged before entering the interval.
